title: Open Problems in Integrable Systems — Nijenhuis operators: singular points and global properties
exact_target: Which generically regular coefficient maps yield a Nijenhuis tensor whose companion-matrix reconstruction stays smooth across all singular points?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2100512 (AMR-020-0512). CC BY 4.0.

Alexey Bolsinov, Vladimir S. Matveev, Eva Miranda and Serge Tabachnikov, Open Problems, Questions, and Challenges in Finite-Dimensional Integrable Systems (2018), Problem 5.14 and its complete preceding definitions. Original question and full discussion.
